verdict.rationale: Bugbot has its own documented natural-language controls. Effort levels can be set by describing in natural language when to use low, default or high effort, and BUGBOT.md files and org rules give review guidelines. However, its operational commands on PRs are fixed keywords (`cursor review`, `bugbot run`, `verbose=true`), not free-form instructions. missing for 10: free-form conversational commanding of Bugbot (e.g., asking it in a PR comment to re-review a specific concern or act on a finding), evidence that BUGBOT.md rules are written in natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe in natural language when Bugbot should use low, default, or high effort. Cursor will dynamically set effort levels based on your instructions.
Manual trigger by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR
Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.
